# US-003: Resolve comments

## User Story

As a Leap Up member, I want to mark handled comments as Resolved, so that everyone sees what is still open.

## Context

Open / Resolved (L80, L131).

## Linked Requirements

| FR | Priority | Notes |
|----|----------|-------|
| [FR-video-review-009](../srs/video-review-spec.md#3-functional-requirements-fr) | P0 | Comment status |

## Acceptance Criteria

<!-- DRAFT — generated by /ac from the draft SRS · AC must be confirmed by PO/QA before it is final -->

### AC-001 — Comment resolved

- **Type:** happy-path
- **Covers:** FR-video-review-009
- **Screen:** video-review

- **Blocked by spec OQ-2** (who may resolve).

```gherkin
Given the client comment "Adjust product visibility" at 00:15 is Open
When {a role allowed by OQ-2} marks it Resolved
Then its status shows "Resolved" for all project members after they reload (no realtime, spec OQ-14)
```

What happens to its timeline marker and the header count on resolve: TBD.

### AC-002 — Not allowed to resolve

- **Type:** permission · **blocked by spec OQ-2**
- **Covers:** FR-video-review-009

```gherkin
Given the comment "Adjust product visibility" is Open
When {a role not allowed by OQ-2} tries to mark it Resolved
Then the status stays "Open"
```

Resolving an already Resolved comment, and re-opening: **blocked by spec OQ-2**.
